title: Creating a Core Graphics Image from a vImage Buffer

segments.source: Creating a Core Graphics Image from a vImage Buffer
segments.ko: vImage 버퍼에서 Core Graphics 이미지 만들기

segments.source: **Framework**: Accelerate
segments.ko: **프레임워크**: Accelerate

segments.source: Create displayable representations of vImage buffers.
segments.ko: vImage 버퍼의 표시 가능한 표현을 생성합니다.

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: vImage provides a function for creating Core Graphics images from vImage buffers.
segments.ko: vImage는 vImage 버퍼에서 Core Graphics 이미지를 생성하는 함수를 제공합니다.

segments.source: This function allows you to display the results of a vImage operation to your user.
segments.ko: 이 함수는 vImage 작업 결과를 사용자에게 표시할 수 있게 합니다.

segments.source: Create the Image
segments.ko: 이미지 생성

segments.source: You create a Core Graphics image from the buffer, and initialize a [`UIImage`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UIImage) instance from that.
segments.ko: 버퍼에서 Core Graphics 이미지를 생성한 다음, 해당 이미지로 [`UIImage`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UIImage) 인스턴스를 초기화합니다.

segments.source: The [`createCGImage(format:flags:)`](vimage_buffer/createcgimage(format:flags:).md) function returns a [`CGImage`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreGraphics/CGImage) instance based on the supplied Core Graphics image format (for more information, see [`Converting bitmap data between Core Graphics images and vImage buffers`](converting-bitmap-data-between-core-graphics-images-and-vimage-buffers.md)).
segments.ko: The [`createCGImage(format:flags:)`](vimage_buffer/createcgimage(format:flags:).md) function returns a [`CGImage`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/CoreGraphics/CGImage) instance based on the supplied Core Graphics image format (for more information, see [`Converting bitmap data between Core Graphics images and vImage buffers`](converting-bitmap-data-between-core-graphics-images-and-vimage-buffers.md)).
